authority: immutable canonical signed events and the existing visibility reducer

current_state.head_membership: highest unsigned created_at, then lowest event_id; verified unsupported heads retain authority
current_state.head_update: refresh the previous and new selected member only
current_state.deletion: retain authorized immutable targets and refresh affected event or selected address keys through a durable bounded queue
current_state.status: one cached header read; never evaluate or decode source history
current_state.ordinary_admission: a ready index advances inside the canonical source transaction; unfinished derived work remains dirty
current_state.empty_source: atomic empty ready header on fresh source-generation insertion
current_state.legacy: forward20 resets derived preparation once, then uses existing bounded source backfill and changed-epoch replay
current_state.readiness: source backfill, changed replay and affected deletion keys all complete at one source fence
current_state.incomplete: VisibilityRebuilding; no stale state advertised current

bounded_reads.selected_keys: limit plus one length-only indexed keys
bounded_reads.event_ids: forced source-generation/event-id index; existing maximum 256 ids
bounded_reads.hydration: only charged returned rows; byte exhaustion returns an honest continuation or SpaceInsufficient
bounded_reads.consistency: header, lengths and hydrated events share one read transaction or memory lock
bounded_reads.fenced_api: EventStore::query_visible_at checks expected EventSourceToken in that same read

maintenance.affected_key_charge: 4096 + target_key_bytes * 16; inspect lengths before payload allocation
maintenance.priority: retained affected targets drain before new source work
maintenance.progress: processed_rows reports materialized source rows; processed_keys reports refreshed deletion keys
maintenance.worker: explicit caller-owned bounded calls; no hidden task
